title: Implementation of the Personalized Care Plan (PCP) Proposed at the End of Step 2 of the ICOPE Program
official: Implementation of the Personalized Care Plan (PCP) Proposed at the End of Step 2 of the ICOPE Program : Description of the Procedures for Negotiating the PCP With the Patient, the Procedures for Implementing the PCP in a Multi-professional Setting, and Implementation of the PCP at 1 Year
summary: The ICOPE (Integrated Care for the Elderly) program is based on an integrated approach including a personalized care plan (PCP). Negotiation methods with the patient and interprofessional cooperation could be key elements in the success of this program. The main objective is to evaluate the feasibility of the implementation of the ICOPE program on the number and content of the PCP carried out at 1 year
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥ 60 years
* ADL ≥ 5.5
* Affiliated or beneficiary of a social security scheme or equivalent.
* having completed a STEP 2 ICOPE
* not opposed to the collection of their data
